personal.name: Umangi Prajapati
personal.title: Senior Frontend Developer
personal.tagline: I build fast, accessible, and scalable web experiences with React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js and AEM Cloud, and I ship AI powered products on the side.
personal.bio:
Senior Frontend Developer with 5+ years of experience building scalable, high performance web applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js and AEM Cloud. I have worked on products used by millions of healthcare members and on customer facing enterprise banking applications, and I care about the full picture: clean architecture, fast load times, accessible interfaces, and reliable test coverage.

My day to day strengths are server side rendering, lazy loading, and caching to improve page performance, reusable component libraries that let teams move faster, and GraphQL and REST integrations that keep data flowing reliably. I enjoy mentoring junior engineers, raising the bar in code reviews, and working closely with product, design, and backend teams to turn requirements into features people actually enjoy using.

Outside of client work I build AI products with Next.js and the OpenAI API, including a streaming chatbot with intent based agents and a resume alignment tool, because I like understanding new technology by shipping something real with it.

experience.summary: Started as a Software Developer and grew into a Senior Frontend Developer, owning frontend delivery for two large healthcare web platforms: the Provider Search Experience (PSX LAWW) and the HR Admin modules, which serve millions of healthcare members. I worked daily in React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, and AEM Cloud, and became a go to engineer for performance, accessibility, testing, and architectural decisions in addition to feature delivery.
responsibilities: Own the frontend of the Provider Search Experience (PSX LAWW) and HR Admin modules from implementation through release, partnering with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to turn requirements into shipped, well tested features.
Design and build scalable, reusable UI components with React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js, Tailwind CSS organized in a monorepo so multiple product teams can share and extend them.
Integrate GraphQL APIs and REST endpoints, agree on API contracts with backend engineers, and handle validation, loading, and error states so users always get clear feedback.
Manage AEM Cloud integrations that streamline content workflows and power dynamic user experiences, including the migration of legacy applications onto AEM Cloud.
Drive performance work using server side rendering, lazy loading, code splitting, and caching strategies, and track the impact through Core Web Vitals such as LCP and CLS.
Write and maintain automated tests with Playwright, Jest, and Enzyme, and keep unit and end to end suites healthy as features evolve.
Enforce WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards using axe-core and screen reader testing as part of the regular development flow.
Conduct code reviews, take part in technical design reviews, mentor junior engineers, and support production issues through debugging and root cause analysis.
Improve CI/CD workflows with Git so that changes move from pull request to release in a smooth, repeatable way.
highlights: Spotted a recurring architectural gap across product teams and built FilterContext, a platform wide filtering framework with cascading state and snapshot based undo. It reduced technical debt by 20% and accelerated feature delivery across the organization.
Refactored and modularized legacy code into maintainable, reusable modules, which improved long term maintainability and made new features faster to build.
Reduced Largest Contentful Paint by 22% and improved Cumulative Layout Shift using SSR, lazy loading, and code splitting, and improved overall page load times by 15% with added caching strategies.
Migrated legacy applications to AEM Cloud, shortening CMS content update cycles by 25% and giving content teams a smoother publishing workflow.
Architected micro frontends with Webpack Module Federation and built reusable component libraries in a monorepo, enabling multiple product teams to develop and release independently.

Introduced Playwright for end to end testing and built automated testing pipelines with Playwright, Jest, and Enzyme. Test coverage rose by 60% and production incidents dropped by 40%, improving application stability and reliability.
Built Node.js REST API endpoints for internal tooling and data driven features, working with backend engineers on contracts, validation, and error handling.
Integrated GraphQL APIs to optimize data fetching, so screens request only the data they need and render faster.
Mentored two junior engineers and reduced their onboarding time by 50%, while holding the team to high code quality standards through thorough code reviews.
Collaborated across product, design, and backend teams and delivered projects with 100% on time delivery.

projects.title: Auriq AI: AI Chatbot
projects.description: A full stack AI chatbot that streams responses in real time using OpenAI GPT-4o mini and the Next.js App Router. Instead of sending every message to a single prompt, it detects the intent of each message and routes it to a specialized agent for weather, math, coding, jokes, or advice, with external API integrations where needed. Conversations are managed as multiple sessions with persistent history stored in the browser through IndexedDB, and the interface is built to feel fast and polished on both desktop and mobile.
highlights: Streams model responses token by token with OpenAI GPT-4o mini, so users see answers as they are generated and perceived latency stays low.
Uses smart intent detection to route messages to specialized agents for weather, math, coding, jokes, and advice, with external API integrations.
Supports a multi chat system with persistent history through IndexedDB and Dexie.js, so conversations survive page reloads.
Protects the API with rate limiting and cooldown enforcement.
Renders math beautifully with KaTeX and uses hydration safe SSR components to avoid mismatches between server and client.
Ships a mobile responsive UI with a light and dark theme toggle, with state managed through Zustand.

projects.title: RoleFit AI: Resume Alignment Tool
projects.description: An AI powered resume tailoring tool that helps job seekers align their resume with a specific job description without inventing experience. Built with the Next.js App Router and OpenAI GPT-4o, it parses an uploaded resume, compares it against the job description, shows which skills are matched or missing, and rewrites content under strict no fabrication rules. Users choose a focus mode, review a before and after alignment score, and export a formatted DOCX, all inside a guided multi step workflow.
highlights: Accepts a resume upload (.docx) or pasted text, with intelligent parsing using Mammoth.
Rewrites resume content with AI under strict no fabrication constraints, so only real experience is reworded.
Runs a keyword matching system that highlights matched and missing skills for the target role.
Calculates an alignment score and shows a before versus after comparison.
Offers multiple focus modes: ATS Optimized, Impact Focused, Balanced, and Concise.
Exports a formatted DOCX using docx and file-saver, covering the full workflow from upload to download.
Keeps progress with session persistence using sessionStorage across the multi step flow.
Delivers a responsive UI with dark and light mode and a clear step by step experience.

projects.title: User Behavior Prediction: Web Log Mining
projects.description: A predictive analytics application that studies historical sales data together with page hit and exit page tracking to forecast how items are likely to sell in the future. It turns raw web log activity into reports that show how visitors move through a site and where they leave.
highlights: Predicts future sales of items sold in previous years based on historical data.
Includes page hit and exit page report modules for understanding visitor flow.
Calculates user interaction patterns and session behavior from web logs.

projects.title: Dogmates: Flutter App
projects.description: A mobile application for dog owners that brings the most common needs into one place: breed information, local events, veterinary clinic locations, accessories shopping, and grooming session locators. Built with Flutter and Dart, with a login and registration flow and three main modules.
highlights: Provides dog breed information and event listings in one app.
Integrates vet clinic locations so owners can find care nearby.
Includes a grooming session locator for male and female dogs.
Implements a login and registration flow with 3 main modules.

projects.title: North County Climate Change Alliance: Website
projects.description: A nonprofit event management website built for the North County Climate Change Alliance. It is a React single page application with dynamic event modules that organizers update every week, backed by a PHP and MySQL server running on XAMPP, and fully responsive across devices.
highlights: Built as a single page application with ReactJS.
Provides dynamic event management modules that are updated weekly.
Uses Bootstrap and CSS Media Queries for full responsiveness on any screen size.
Runs on a PHP and MySQL backend with a XAMPP server.

projects.title: Cloud Marketing with Image Processing
projects.description: An online shopping platform that uses image processing to filter and surface products intelligently. Shoppers can upload an image or search by keyword, and the platform shows relevant items based on visual matching. Built as a ReactJS single page application with a PHP and MySQL backend.
highlights: Supports image upload or keyword search with processing based filtering.
Displays relevant items based on visual matching.
Built as a ReactJS SPA with a PHP and MySQL backend.

projects.title: Face Recognition and Password Authentication
projects.description: An Android app that adds biometric security by using facial recognition as a login password. A user's face is stored as the password during registration, and returning users authenticate by showing their face instead of typing a secret.
highlights: Stores the user's face as a password during registration.
Provides biometric login for returning users.
Implemented natively for Android.

projects.title: Online Voting System
projects.description: A digital voting application that lets citizens vote for their preferred political party from anywhere. It covers secure voter registration and authentication, with a simple and accessible interface built with C# and Visual Studio.
highlights: Allows remote voting from any device.
Includes secure voter registration and authentication.
Offers a basic but accessible UI built with C# and Visual Studio.
